source: Poly Haven (https://polyhaven.com) and ambientCG (https://ambientcg.com), both CC0, 1k JPG, colour and DirectX normal maps
swap: To use other textures (Megascans, say) set a layer's "source" to "local" and put <layer>_color.jpg|png and <layer>_normal.jpg|png (DirectX normals) in game/Content/ThirdParty/TerrainTextures/, then run the TerrainMaterials commandlet again. Nothing else changes.
fields: source: polyhaven, ambientcg or local. id: the texture's name on that site. tileMetres: metres one repeat of the texture covers. roughness: 0 shiny to 1 matt.

slope.note: the ground's up-facing normal (1 flat) below rockFrom starts to turn into rock and is all rock at rockFull
